## What was built

**`docs/demo/DEMO12_ADVISOR_15_MIN.md`** — 15-minute demo script specifically for procurement advisors and consulting leads evaluating AbarVa as a practice tool.

### Script structure

| Section | Minutes | Content |
|---|---|---|
| Opening: The Advisor's Problem | 0–2 | Verbal — status assembly overhead, where advisor value is |
| Programme Status in 60 Seconds | 2–5 | Live programme detail page |
| Commercial Risk in 90 Seconds | 5–8 | Source event — vendor comparison, BAFO, risks |
| Intelligence Grounding | 8–11 | Sentinel pattern library |
| The Advisor's Value Proposition | 11–13 | What AbarVa does / does not do for an advisor |
| Pilot Mechanics | 13–15 | How to start a pilot — next steps |

### Key features

- Advisor-specific framing: "makes you more valuable — not replaces you"
- Five advisor-specific Q&A responses (white-label, sensitive data, billing model, white-label, AI decisions)
- No client ROI claims — value described as "bandwidth multiplication" and "intelligence grounding"
- Fabrication policy header
- Pilot mechanics section with concrete next steps
